# FG-GIT-0033

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 400 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `an_ssh_command_other_than_git_is_refused` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: SSH では git の clone・fetch・push だけが使えます。リポジトリの URL を確かめてください。
- en: Only git clone, fetch and push are available over SSH. Check the repository URL.
- id: Melalui SSH hanya git clone, fetch, dan push yang tersedia. Periksa URL repositori.

## 原因 (cause)

M4 C13 (ADR-0033): an authenticated SSH client asked the SSH git transport for something it does not serve. `reason`: `not_git` (an exec command other than `git-upload-pack` / `git-receive-pack`, e.g. `git-upload-archive` or a shell command), `malformed` (the command line is not `<command> '<path>'`: an unterminated quote, more than one argument, a control character, longer than 1 KiB), `path_invalid` (the repository path is empty, longer than 512 bytes, has an empty or dot-leading segment, or a character outside `A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ - /`), `shell` (an interactive shell: `ssh git@host` — the client is told who it is signed in as, then the channel ends with exit status 1), `second_command` (a second exec or shell on the same channel), `push_options` (a push asked for the `push-options` capability, which the server never advertises; answered on side-band 3 when the push negotiated a side-band). Refused requests that carry no answer text (a pty, a subsystem such as sftp, X11 or agent forwarding, port forwarding, an environment variable other than `GIT_PROTOCOL`) are answered `failure` without a log line. Nothing reaches git or the HTTP layer and nothing is authorized: the refusal is before any resource is named.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

One info log line `forge.ssh.command_refused` with `error_code=FG-GIT-0033`, `request_id` (the SSH command's id), `reason`, `ssh_key_id`, `user_id` and (for `not_git`) `command` (the first word, at most 64 characters; never the whole line). The client prints `fatal: remote error: FG-GIT-0033 … (request_id: …)` (exec) or the text on stderr (shell).

## 対処 (fix)

Use a clone URL of the form `ssh://git@<host>:<port>/<group>/<project>.git` (the SSH keys page shows the host and port). A client that sends another command is not a git client: nothing to fix on the server.
